criteria.passage: I’d probably prioritize a rollback or patch plan before doing a lot of reproduction work
criteria.rationale: The candidate explicitly deprioritizes reproduction work in favor of rollback/patching, which materially contradicts the criterion of establishing how to reproduce or characterise the failure.
The answer mentions symptoms and logs, but does not clearly compare failing conditions against working behaviour or describe checking what differs when things work versus fail.

The candidate suggests blaming the release and having teams inspect their diffs, but does not clearly show a systematic narrowing process based on observations to progressively reduce the set of plausible causes.

annotation.annotation_notes: The response is action-oriented but mostly jump-starts mitigation. It provides limited diagnostic detail, so only the explicit de-prioritization of reproduction rises to negative evidence.
